Token on every request

The relay keeps nothing; the daemon still checks
the access token on each forwarded request.
--no-relay keeps traffic on the local network.
Source: README.md
Works without the daemon

MCP finds the daemon via runtime/daemon.json
port+token; if it is down it reads and writes
.vibeprint/ directly and the canvas picks it up
later.
Source: src/core/daemon-client.ts
Approval gate

The agent rule says to propose structural changes
as marks and wait for approval; MCP reports
'Waiting for the user…' progress in daemon mode.
Source: src/mcp/server.ts
